obligation: FTC Safeguards Rule: Tax and Advisory
basis: 16 CFR 314.2(h)(2)(viii) names an accountant or tax preparation service that completes income tax returns; individual tax clients are customers (314.2(e)(2)(i)(H)). Customer information on about 24 million consumers, so the 314.6 exception for fewer than 5,000 consumers is not available

obligation: FTC Safeguards Rule: CPA Partners
applies: No (not a financial institution for its attest work)
basis: CPA Partners performs audits, reviews and SOC examinations and prepares no tax returns

obligation: FTC Safeguards Rule: Wealth
basis: Wealth is an SEC-registered investment adviser, assigned to the SEC under GLBA section 505(a)(5); 314.1(b) excludes institutions under another regulator's section 505 authority

obligation: FTC Safeguards Rule: Practice Cloud
applies: Yes (flowed down as a service provider to customer firms)
basis: Customer firms are Safeguards Rule financial institutions; Practice Cloud's customer agreements carry security addenda. Group legal treats it as a service provider, not a financial institution (2026-06-10)

obligation: FTC Safeguards Rule: holding company as affiliate
applies: Yes (affiliate providing the Qualified Individual and shared services)
basis: The Group CISO, employed by the holding company, is Tax and Advisory's Qualified Individual, so 314.4(a)(1) to (3) apply

obligation: IRC 7216 preparer disclosure and use limits: Tax and Advisory
basis: Tax and Advisory and every employee who assists in preparation are preparers; tax return information goes to Wealth through the referral interface and to model providers through the AI tools

obligation: IRC 7216: CPA Partners
basis: Tax work is done by Tax and Advisory, not CPA Partners

obligation: IRC 7216: Wealth
basis: Wealth receives tax return information only under Tax and Advisory's consents and may use only what a valid consent covers; the duty sits with the preparer

obligation: IRC 7216: Practice Cloud
basis: Practice Cloud holds itself out to tax return preparers as providing document exchange and Form 8879 e-signature (2026-06-10 position)

obligation: IRC 7216: corporate shared services
applies: No (not a preparer; operates systems under contractor terms)
basis: Corporate operates systems that hold tax return information on Tax and Advisory's behalf

obligation: IRS e-file and WISP guidance: Tax and Advisory
applies: Yes (Authorized IRS e-file Provider acting as ERO)
basis: Tax and Advisory is an ERO with the Chief Tax Officer as Responsible Official; every preparer holds a PTIN

obligation: IRS e-file guidance: Practice Cloud
basis: Practice Cloud provides Form 8879 e-signature to customer firms

obligation: IRS e-file guidance: CPA Partners, Wealth and group
basis: None of them is an e-file provider or prepares returns

obligation: FAR Basic Safeguarding clause: all divisions and group
basis: No federal contracts or subcontracts in any division

obligation: DFARS 252.204-7012 and CMMC: all divisions and group
basis: No defense contracts or subcontracts in any division

obligation: HIPAA as business associate: CPA Partners
applies: Yes (business associate of about 85 health care audit clients)
basis: CPA Partners audits about 85 HIPAA covered entities under business associate agreements

obligation: HIPAA as subcontractor: holding company
applies: Yes (subcontractor for PHI on SYS-T3; not yet papered)
basis: The holding company runs SYS-T3 and group services that hold CPA Partners' PHI under the 2021 administrative services agreement, which has no business associate terms

obligation: HIPAA: Tax and Advisory, Wealth and Practice Cloud
basis: The TPCP holds no PHI; Wealth holds no PHI; Practice Cloud offers no business associate agreements

obligation: ABA Model Rules 1.1 and 1.6(c): all divisions and group
basis: No division practices law

obligation: AICPA confidentiality rule: CPA Partners
basis: Binds CPA Partners' CPAs through state boards of accountancy; it is not law and its text was not verified from the source for this sample

obligation: CIRCIA: all divisions and group
basis: No final rule; tracked as a pending change

obligation: PCAOB registration and standards: CPA Partners
basis: CPA Partners audits no SEC issuer and is not registered

obligation: Circular 230 due diligence: Tax and Advisory and CPA Partners
applies: Yes (CPAs and enrolled agents who practice before the IRS)
basis: Tax and Advisory practitioners sign returns and represent clients before the IRS; AI-002 and AI-003 draft tax treatments and notice replies

obligation: GLBA privacy and safeguards: Tax and Advisory and Wealth
applies: Yes (through 16 CFR 314 for Tax and Advisory and 17 CFR 248 for Wealth)
basis: Both hold consumers' nonpublic personal information; GLBA is applied through the FTC rule and Regulation S-P rows

obligation: Interagency bank security guidelines: all divisions
citation: 12 CFR 30 App. B and parallel rules
basis: No bank or trust company in the group

obligation: FTC Safeguards Rule (finance industry list)
basis: Same rule as N54-R01, recorded per entity above

obligation: NYDFS Cybersecurity Regulation: all divisions
basis: No group entity is licensed by the New York Department of Financial Services

obligation: SEC Regulation S-P: Wealth
basis: 17 CFR 248.30(d)(3) covers an investment adviser registered with the SEC; Wealth is a larger entity with a compliance date of 2025-12-03

obligation: SEC Regulation S-P: Tax and Advisory and corporate as Wealth's service providers
basis: Tax and Advisory holds integrated planning data for Wealth under the 2022 agreement; corporate provides shared services under the amended 2025-11 agreement. Wealth carries the duty to oversee them

obligation: SEC Regulation S-P: CPA Partners and Practice Cloud
basis: Neither is a covered institution or holds Wealth customer information

obligation: SEC Regulation S-ID: Wealth
basis: Counsel determined in 2024 that Wealth is within the rule because advisory agreements let it direct transfers to third parties on client instruction

obligation: SEC Regulation S-ID: other divisions
basis: No other group entity is an SEC-registered adviser or broker-dealer

obligation: Advisers Act compliance and books-and-records rules: Wealth
basis: Wealth is an SEC-registered investment adviser with a compliance program and records duties

obligation: NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law: all divisions
basis: No insurance company in the group

obligation: SEC cybersecurity disclosure (also N51-R08): group
basis: The holding company is an SEC registrant; divisions contribute incident facts through the group

obligation: NCUA security program: all divisions
basis: No credit union in the group

obligation: OCC heightened standards: all divisions
basis: No bank in the group

obligation: FTC Act Section 5: all divisions and group
applies: Yes (Practice Cloud security and AI claims; general for Tax and Advisory, CPA Partners and group; limited for Wealth's SEC-regulated activity)
basis: Practice Cloud markets the AI document intake feature as "99% accurate"

obligation: COPPA Rule: Practice Cloud and group
basis: No child-directed service

obligation: CCPA and CPPA regulations: all divisions
applies: Yes (limited: GLBA-covered data is exempt at the data level; Practice Cloud as a service provider)
basis: Customer firms that are CCPA businesses sign Practice Cloud's data processing addendum with service provider terms

obligation: DOJ Data Security Program: all divisions and group
basis: The group holds bulk personal financial data; Practice Cloud uses offshore development contractors

obligation: Protecting Americans' Data from Foreign Adversaries Act: all divisions
basis: Group revenue comes from tax, accounting, attest, wealth management and SaaS fees; no line of business sells or transfers personal data as a data broker

obligation: FCC CPNI rules: all divisions
basis: No telecommunications carrier in the group

obligation: FedRAMP: Practice Cloud
basis: No federal agency customers

obligation: SEC cybersecurity disclosure: group
basis: Same as N52-R08

obligation: Florida Information Protection Act (breach notification): all divisions
basis: Headquarters in Florida and about 21% of individual tax clients live there; Practice Cloud is a third-party agent to customer firms under 501.171(6). Other states' laws apply where affected individuals reside (Florida is the worked example)

obligation: Florida recording consent law: Wealth meeting assistant
basis: The meeting assistant records client meetings; advisers meet clients in 40 states, so the all-party rule is applied everywhere

obligation: Colorado automated decision-making law: all divisions
basis: No AI use case makes or materially influences a consequential decision about a person

obligation: HIPAA Security Rule NPRM: CPA Partners
basis: Not a final rule; tracked because it would change CPA Partners' business associate duties

obligation: Administrative services agreement (2021): holding company, Tax and Advisory and CPA Partners
basis: Sets the services CPA Partners buys; has no security, incident notice or business associate subcontractor terms

obligation: Integrated planning agreement (2022): Wealth and Tax and Advisory
basis: Governs integrated planning data that Tax and Advisory holds for Wealth; no 72-hour service provider notice term

obligation: Intercompany services agreement: holding company and Wealth
basis: Amended 2025-11 with the 72-hour service provider notice term

obligation: Practice Cloud master agreement (2024) with Tax and Advisory
basis: Internal service provider terms with a 72-hour incident notice

obligation: Practice Cloud customer agreements: Practice Cloud
basis: Incident notice within 72 hours (24 hours for 140 enterprise customers), security addendum, sub-processor notice and data processing addendum

obligation: SOC 2 commitments: Practice Cloud and client accounting services
citation: AICPA Trust Services Criteria; customer contracts
applies: Yes (Practice Cloud annually; first readiness for client accounting services); tax preparation, Wealth and CPA Partners out of scope
basis: Practice Cloud issues an annual Type 2 report; 60 client accounting services clients asked for a SOC 2 report in 2026
